verdict.rationale: The Dashboard page shows total controls, controls with owners, and flags controls needing attention. The Compliance Roadmap can filter Unified Controls by framework and group them by Status, which gives a per-framework view of passing versus open controls; the Monitors page also supports managing audit readiness. No evidence shows a single readiness percentage per framework or an explicit 'what's left to audit-ready' summary, so the operations lead must piece readiness together from status groupings. Missing for 10: a documented per-framework readiness percentage/score, an explicit passing-vs-gap count per framework on the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
